candidate.answerReason: Each of the three interior-exterior linear pairs sums to 180°, giving a combined total of 3 × 180° = 540°. The exterior angles alone sum to 360°.

methods.label: Sum three linear pairs
methods.explanation: At each vertex, the interior and exterior angles sum to \(180^\circ\). At the three vertices, the total is \(3\times180^\circ=540^\circ\). Subtracting the interior angle sum of \(180^\circ\) gives an exterior angle sum of \(360^\circ\).
methods.levelReason: Uses supplementary linear pairs, elementary multiplication, and the Grade 8 triangle angle sum.
